faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: How do I receive my product?
faq.a1: After successful payment you will receive an email with secure download links. You can also access your purchases from My Account → My Downloads.
faq.a2: Yes. All products are digital downloads. No physical items are shipped.
faq.q3: Can I use the products on my phone?
faq.a3: Most products are PDF or common formats compatible with phones, tablets and computers. Check the product page for specific compatibility.
faq.q4: When will I receive my download?
faq.a4: Immediately after payment confirmation. Downloads are available within seconds.
faq.q5: Can I download the product more than once?
faq.a5: Yes. You can re-download your purchased files from your account for a limited period as stated in the license.
faq.q6: What payment methods do you accept?
faq.a6: We accept major credit/debit cards via Stripe and PayPal. Additional methods may be added later.
faq.a7: Due to the nature of digital products, refunds are handled according to our Refund Policy. Please review it before purchasing.
faq.a8: Email us at support@example.com or use the contact form. We typically respond within 24–48 hours.
